def run(f, npar):
    best=None
    for c0 in [0.2,0.42,0.6,1.0,2.0]:
        for k0 in [0.03,0.06,0.1,0.3,1.0]:
            def r(p):
                X=np.column_stack([np.sqrt(P), np.sin(p[0]*t)*P, f(t,P,p), np.ones_like(t)])
                coef=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
                return X@coef-y
            try:
                s=least_squares(r,[c0,k0,k0][:npar+1] if npar<2 else [c0,k0,k0],x_scale='jac')
                v=np.sum(s.fun**2)
